name: Lock & Key: Markings Side Story
source:
Reaki Kariyata is the Princess of Akeens, a special race, in Western Yardrill. However, she holds many secrets such as not actually being born a royal member to the Kariyata Family and being the key to preventing a secret war devised by both sides.

We see Reaki face the many hardships of what it means to come from a different race. She takes on the name Harim to defer suspicion from her fellow classmates when she enrolls as the Akeen Representative for her people to strengthen relationships. The only ones who know her real identity are the Principal and herself, but even he is in the dark about who she really is.

Reaki is in search of two special weapons that she holds dear to her heart.

In time, she makes many friends. She manages to make connections she didn't think she'd be able to have. However, the war is approaching. She grows scared with plaguing nightmares of her past. 

[i]I'm running out of time...I can't linger any longer...I have to hurry.[/i]

Reaki can only hope she'll save both sides of one country.

[From [url=https://visualbutterfly.itch.io/lock-and-key-markings-side-story]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
Reaki Kariyata是西雅德里尔的一个特殊种族埃金斯的公主。然而，她掌握着许多秘密，例如实际上并不是刈矢太家的皇室成员，并且是阻止双方策划的秘密战争的关键。

我们看到雷基面临着来自不同种族的许多困难。当她注册为阿肯代表以加强与她的人民的关系时，她用哈林这个名字来避免同学的怀疑。唯一知道她真实身份的人是校长和她自己，但就连他也不知道她到底是谁。

雷基正在寻找两件她珍视的特殊武器。

随着时间的推移，她结交了很多朋友。她设法建立了她认为自己无法建立的联系。然而，战争即将来临。她因过去的噩梦而感到害怕。

[i]我的时间不多了……我不能再耽搁了……我得快点了。[/i]

雷基只能希望她能拯救一个国家的双方。

[来自[url=https://visualbutterfly.itch.io/lock-and-key-markings-side-story]Itch.io[/url]]
